facts.statement: The indicator uses a signal threshold of 110 dBm.
The indicator covers the UK as of January 2026.
The data source is Ofcom.
The indicator was published on 13 May 2026.
The indicator contains data only for January 2026.
Confidence intervals are not available for this indicator.
The map is available at lower-tier or unitary-authority geography.
A bar-chart view is available.
A table view is available.
The dataset is downloadable in XLSX, CSV and CSVW formats.
ONS warns that aggregation may cause differences from other published figures.
The original source data is linked back to Ofcom.
The May 2026 Project Gigabit contract publication was updated on 20 July 2026.
The publication is licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0 except where otherwise stated.
Two contracts showed a reduction in reported built premises because of supplier data resubmissions.
The affected contracts were Bedfordshire, Northamptonshire and Milton Keynes, and North Shropshire.
The publication says the removed delivery records were due to be replaced with revised data.
The revisions reflect administrative-data updates rather than a change in delivery performance.
Users are instructed to use caution when comparing the affected contracts with previous publications.
BDUK publishes monthly contract-level Project Gigabit progress data.
Contracted-premises figures cover initial scope only and may omit deferred-scope premises.
The management figures are not directly comparable with BDUK official statistics.
The table is a snapshot of BDUK data held on 21 May 2026.
Variable ingestion lag means the figures should not be used to assess contractual milestones.
